newsitem.title: MALTA: Libyan minister to hold talks with Malta's premier.
newsitem.headline: Libyan minister to hold talks with Malta's premier.

text.p: Libyan Foreign Minister Omar Mustafa al-Montasser will visit Malta on Friday to meet Prime Minister Alfred Sant in the first official high-level meetings since Malta's Labour government took power.
The Libyan embassy said on Thursday Montasser would also hold talks with Foreign Minister George Vella.
The Labour government was elected in October on a pledge to stop Malta's application to join the European Union and give as much attention to Mediterranean foreign policy as to Europe.

Friday's meetings will take place less than two weeks before the second Euro-Med foreign ministers' meeting due to be attended by all EU and Mediterranean Arab foreign ministers except Libya, which was not invited.

Sant said last week that Malta regretted Libya had not been invited. He said the Maltese government would continue to respect United Nations sanctions imposed on Libya over the Lockerbie aircraft bombing, but believed a decision by the Security Council not to renew the sanctions was long overdue.
